title: Pawprint: Bug Walkies
tagline: A pawsitively tiny game from PostHog

text.win: Every walk booked, every sitter paid, every crash fetched. Good dev. Very good dev.
text.lose: The bugs chewed up the booking flow. Have a treat and try again.
text.credits: Made with love (and dog puns) for Pawprint by PostHog
